source_title: Fixture permitted activities
retrieved_date: "2026-08-23"
---
As a Standard Visitor you can do tourism, visit family and friends, attend
business meetings and conferences, and take part in some permitted paid
engagements. You cannot work, claim public funds, or live in the UK through
frequent or long visits.
